name: kube-score-container-level-pod-check-outcomes
instr:
kube-score cannot report pod findings for individual workloads, containers, init containers, and related objects. Add structured, subject-scoped outcomes while preserving aggregate scoring and default output.

Structured pod checks in the container, security, probe, network-policy, and topology-spread families must return deterministically ordered outcomes and one legacy-compatible aggregate. Its grade is the lowest non-skipped grade, and it is skipped only when every outcome is skipped. Preserve grades, comments, metadata, exemptions, and errors. Empty assessments are valid; callback errors never become critical assessments.

Container and security outcomes must distinguish regular and identically named init containers. Security inheritance must respect overrides without mutating inputs. Empty-container findings stay workload-scoped. Probe outcomes must distinguish containers, Service relationships, untargeted workloads, Jobs, and CronJobs. Network-policy outcomes independently represent ingress, egress, and namespace-valid matching policies; keep multiple matching policies as separate related subjects. Topology-spread outcomes remain workload-only.

Accumulate each assessment exactly once beside existing meta and resource results. Produce one aggregate score without duplicating scorecard resource identity.
